newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Northland Cranberries buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Northland Cranberries buy repeated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Thursday she reiterated her buy rating on Northland Cranberries Inc, which spoke Wednesday at Dain's conference on growth stocks.

-- "Management said the company has achieved much success in the national roll-out of its branded 100 percent juice products," Wittenburg wrote in a report. "The company's branded national product launch began in 1995, and is currently in various stages of distribution. Specifically, Northland has gained strong entry into several markets in the U.S."
-- She added the product roll-out is being supported through promotional allowances, coupons, in-store promotions and advertising.
-- Northland also has additional growth opportunities including its entry into the private label market.

-- "According to management, Northland's average revenue per barrel (of cranberries) could grow to around $750-$1,000 per barrel if Northland put its entire cranberry crop into its Northland brand juice products," Wittenburg said. "Of course, expenses would also increase."
